answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity registers against an operator-signed cipher binding the wallet to a legal entity, with a per-identity escrow held by the operator. A sonnet of reputation accrues to the operator, not the wallet. When collusion detection flags a cluster, the operator forfeits the entire escrow pool behind every linked wallet, not just the flagged one. A sparrow of a single sybil costs the operator the full pool, so mass cloning self-punishes at the entity level.
